name: Watchino Fine Watches
description: A Layout for a fine-watch shop drawn like a watch dial: graphite ink on cool dial white with heat-blued steel. Its signature is a fixed chapter-ring index rail down the left edge that doubles as scroll progress, with section dividers made of minute markers. A dark announcement bar over a centred Bodoni Moda wordmark, with Collections (a mega menu of the collections' cut-outs), the top collection, Journal and Client care. The home: a photo hero with the words on its dark side, a service strip read from the shop's own delivery and payment settings, the collections as a hairline grid of cut-outs, three price registers, a spotlight on the most precious reference on graphite, new arrivals in a hairline rail, how a watch reaches you beside the shop's photos, client care and the journal. A collection page with a filter column (collection, brand, a logarithmic price track and the watches' real specification) and a hairline grid; a product page with a thumbnail column, a sticky details column, finish swatches and the specification table; compare, the bag drawer and the whole checkout. A gallery, not a funnel: no badges, no timers, a reduced price shown as a muted struck-through figure. One colour family from the chosen palette (Blued steel by default; Racing green, Burgundy, Bronze or any colour), light by default with a dark mode; Bodoni Moda over Archivo with Azeret Mono figures; hairline rules and 4 px corners. English, German, Spanish, French and Arabic.
